drone.episode_note: A routine mission starts in a healthy envelope, drops into a low-battery conservation path, then loses comms entirely before the original mission envelope is restored.

steps.event_note: Battery and communications are healthy, so the mission continues normally.
Battery margin drops and the safe move becomes battery conservation.
Communications are lost entirely and the drone leaves the audited action space, so the runtime must fail closed or execute only a safe fallback.
Communications are restored and the original continue-mission envelope returns.

drone.episode_note: A signal-recovery climb turns into a stationary hold when obstacles spike, then loses enough altitude headroom that no audited maneuver remains before the recovery climb becomes valid again.

steps.event_note: A degraded comms state with ample headroom supports a signal-recovery climb.
Obstacle density rises and the safe action becomes holding position.
Altitude headroom collapses and the drone exits the audited maneuver set, so the runtime must safely reject the step.
Headroom is restored and the climb-for-signal action is valid again.

drone.episode_note: A contested, high-threat flight begins in supervised manual handoff, briefly de-escalates into a stationary hold, then loses every non-fallback action before supervised handoff becomes valid again.

steps.event_note: Contested airspace and a feasible operator takeover justify manual handoff.
Threat intensity drops, so the safe supported move becomes holding position instead of handing off.
Airspace briefly clears but no audited non-fallback control action remains, so the runtime should safely reject or execute only the generic fallback path.
Contestation returns and the supervised manual handoff envelope is valid again.

drone.episode_note: A denied-airspace safety descent loses the autonomy envelope entirely, then recovers and remains stable once autonomous recovery is allowed again.

steps.event_note: With denied airspace and a safe landing zone available, the correct action is to descend for safety.
Autonomous recovery authority is revoked, leaving the drone outside the audited action space and forcing a safe rejection.
Autonomous recovery is reauthorized, restoring the safety descent envelope.
The recovered descent envelope remains stable at a later checkpoint.

finance.episode_note: A previously low-risk payment warms into monitored traffic, then spikes into an unsupported fraud state before returning to a clean approval path.

steps.event_note: The transaction is clean and low risk.
The anomaly score rises into the monitored band, but the case remains supported.
The anomaly score jumps again, but no audited finance action covers this exact state and the system should fail closed.
The signal clears and the original low-risk approval path becomes valid again.

finance.episode_note: A docs-gated transaction briefly escalates into compliance review, then becomes unsupported when the transfer upsizes before documentation is repaired.

steps.event_note: Missing or mismatched documents keep the payment on the additional-docs path.
A sanctions signal appears and pushes the case into formal compliance escalation.
The sanctions signal clears, but the transfer is now too large for the docs-only path and should fail closed.
The payment is resized back into the audited docs-collection envelope.

finance.episode_note: A throttled account escalates into an immediate freeze, then drops into an unsupported KYC-incomplete state before the throttled policy resumes.

steps.event_note: High velocity with elevated anomaly supports a temporary limit reduction.
The anomaly score spikes to severe and the account should be frozen immediately.
The KYC snapshot drops out while the account remains hot, leaving no audited action and requiring fail-closed behavior.
KYC data returns and the temporary-limit path is again valid.

finance.episode_note: A high-jurisdiction EDD case briefly falls outside the audited envelope when the anomaly score spikes past the modeled review boundary, then returns and remains stable.

steps.event_note: High-jurisdiction very-high-value traffic enters enhanced due diligence.
The anomaly score spikes again, but no audited finance action covers this exact combination and the system should fail closed.
The prior-incident signal is cleared and the EDD route returns.
The recovered EDD state remains stable at a later checkpoint.

steps.event_note: Standard low-risk access is auto-approvable.
The request scope expands and now requires bounded manager review.

The operator removes the unsupported emergency scope and the original standard approval path returns.

iam.episode_note: Privileged access is routed back into security review, then leaves the audited contract through an unsupported emergency session before the approved privileged state returns.

steps.event_note: Approved elevated access is granted in a timeboxed window.
New SoD concern reopens the security review gate.
The request is then forced into an emergency session without a break-glass envelope and must fail closed.
Review closes and the approved timeboxed privileged state returns.

iam.episode_note: A valid break-glass grant loses its ticket linkage, should fail closed, then recovers and stays stable under the audited emergency envelope.

steps.event_note: Primary on-call break-glass access is granted under the emergency contract.
The break-glass ticket link is lost, so the runtime must fail closed instead of granting by similarity.
The emergency ticket is restored and the same break-glass action becomes supportable again.
The audited emergency state remains stable at a later checkpoint.

iam.episode_note: A hard-stop denial remains valid, then drifts into an unsupported persistent-admin state before returning to the same denial lane.

steps.event_note: A denied critical admin request stays in the explicit denial lane.
The request then drifts into a persistent critical-admin state that is intentionally outside the live IAM contract.
The unsupported persistent grant attempt is withdrawn and the request returns to explicit denial.
The hard-stop denial remains stable after the unsupported drift is corrected.

sre.episode_note: A service enters readonly protection, briefly recovers enough for horizontal scale-out, then falls into an unsupported coordination state before readonly mode is restored.

steps.event_note: Writes are unavailable and the safe action is to enable readonly mode.
The write path comes back and the service can scale out instead of staying readonly.
The write path fails again, but the control plane view no longer matches any audited action envelope and the router must fail closed.
The control-plane state realigns with the readonly contract and the original protective action is valid again.

sre.episode_note: A degraded service initially looks restartable, then fresh deployment evidence turns the correct move into rollback, before the trail goes stale and the system must fail closed.

steps.event_note: Local service degradation still supports a targeted restart.
Fresh regression evidence arrives and rollback becomes the only supported action.
The rollback trail goes stale before execution, leaving no audited action and forcing a fail-closed pause.
The deploy evidence clears and the incident returns to the original restartable shape.

sre.episode_note: A regional outage initially supports failover, then drifts outside the contract when the control plane drops out, before returning to a valid failover state.

steps.event_note: Regional failure still sits inside the audited failover envelope.
The regional incident deepens and the control plane disappears, leaving no audited action path.
Control-plane visibility returns and the original failover action is valid again.
The failover decision remains stable at a later checkpoint.

sre.episode_note: A hot node initially supports targeted draining, then slips outside the node-locality boundary before the drain plan becomes valid again.

steps.event_note: The faulty node remains well localized and can be drained safely.
Locality becomes ambiguous and the router must fail closed rather than drain the wrong target.
Node-locality sharpens again and the targeted drain becomes valid.
The recovered drain decision remains stable at a later checkpoint.
